[tool-call run_code] {"code": "
const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
 "const http=require('http');",
 "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
 "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36';",
 "function get(u,acc){return new Promise(function(resolve,reject){",
 " const pu=new URL(u);",
 " http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:u,headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept':acc||'application/json'}},function(res){",
 " const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
 " res.on('end',function(){resolve({status:res.statusCode, body:Buffer.concat(c).toString('utf8'), hdr:res.headers})});",
 " }).on('error',reject);",
 "});}",
 "const targets=[",
 " ['ph_rss','https://www.producthunt.com/feed'],",
 " ['ph_rss2','https://www.producthunt.com/feed.atom'],",
 " ['gumroad_api','https://gumroad.com/api/v2/products'],",
 " ['gumroad_discover_json','https://gumroad.com/discover?sort=best_selling&format=json'],",
 " ['appsumo_api','https://appsumo.com/api/v1/deals/'],",
 " ['indiehackers_api','https://www.indiehackers.com/api/posts?limit=20']",
 "];",
 "(async function(){",
 " for(const t of targets){",
 " try{",
 " const r=await get(t[1], t[0].indexOf('rss')>=0?'application/rss+xml, application/atom+xml':'application/json, text/html');",
 " console.log('=== '+t[0]+' -> '+r.status+' len='+r.body.length+' ct='+((r.hdr['content-type']||'').slice(0,40)));",
 " console.log(' ' + r.body.substring(0,220).replace(/\\s+/g,' '));",
 " }catch(e){ console.log(t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); }",
 " await new Promise(function(x){setTimeout(x,3000)});",
 " }",
 "})();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-r2.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-r2.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Probe Product Hunt Gumroad AppSumo APIs", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 6000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
